fusions.name: Rug from Under
fusions.desc: Whips a length of cloth along the ground and yanks it out from under the first enemy it meets, dealing 11 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Unfurled Spin
fusions.desc: Spins on one heel with your cloak flared, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Each hit has a 30% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Folded Silhouette
fusions.desc: You and your allies are veiled for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later. Attacking breaks the veil.

fusions.name: Layer upon Layer
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
